def: a couch; by extension, cohabitation; by implication, the male sperm

occurrences.text: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
